name: 86 Chaos 16.0.22 Active Recipes, Crash Alerts, and Runtime Safety Fix
label: 86 Chaos 16.0.22 Active Recipes, Crash Alerts, and Runtime Safety Fix
notes: Fixes the active mounted Recipes screen rather than the old compatibility component.
Adds ChunkLoadError reporting and one-shot recovery for stale hashed chunks.
Adds server-only crash email notification support and clearer push notification status.
Tightens QA cleanup safety and Schedule Auto-Fill identity/partial-batch handling.
Adds shared live-query subscription reuse and no-op write counters for Firebase cost reduction work.
releaseNotes: Active Recipes scanner, modal, edit, filter, and parse helpers are null-safe in the mounted operations screen.
Runtime crash reporting now preserves sanitized ChunkLoadError diagnostics and uses a non-blank recovery boundary.
Crash reports can email configured support recipients through server-only BUG_REPORT_EMAIL_* variables.
Push notification status distinguishes FCM acceptance from confirmed device delivery/open events.
Full Audit QA cleanup fails closed on query/user safety errors and protects custom-claim administrators.
Schedule Auto-Fill rejects ambiguous name-only identities and reports partial batch commits honestly.
Shared useLiveCollection listeners reuse identical Firestore queries and avoid quick visibility churn; no-op push/workspace writes are counted/skipped where implemented.
